page.overview:
Who is Cake the Cat?

Cake the Cat is an Adventure Time minifigure that appears in LEGO Fortnite.

Cake the Cat is a purchasable skin in-game with the Cake the Cat Bundle for 1,600 V-Bucks or with the Fionna and Cake Bundle for 2,800 V-Bucks.
